comment=Existing 2 s record shown 20x slower. No AO rerun. Calibrated F164N surface brightness convolved with saved 1.65 um PSFs; fixed display stretch.
operations: Decode the already published 960x896 WebP presentation. No optical model, convolution, AO or metrics are recalculated.
Repeat each existing image at constant 60 fps. Preserve every original image, including frame 736. No blending or motion interpolation.
Encode H.264 with 4:2:0 chroma and fast-start MP4. This is a lossy sharing copy, not scientific image data.
